dedupe_keys.name: urban microwave backscatter analysis r code

description: This GitHub repository contains R scripts and supporting CSV material for analysing the ERS, QuikSCAT and ASCAT urban microwave backscatter time series. It is linked from the Scientific Data descriptor and names the urban backscatter analysis in its own README. A modeller can inspect the processing steps before using satellite backscatter as a proxy for urban form or change in an exposure scenario. The code is an analysis workflow, not a direct building inventory; sensor changes and environmental effects still need separate interpretation. GitHub reports CC0 for the repository. I read own metadata and README without cloning the code, running R or checking the satellite grids. The related NASA SEDAC NetCDF data form a separate G1 item and have no item-specific licence confirmed here. No exact catalogue software record was found. A limitation is that the scripts do not turn radar values into verified building counts without separate ground truth.
